Thanks all — great alignment. A few quick notes ahead of the call tomorrow:

- For sustained 150–200 QPS we typically recommend a 4× GPU pool with an autoscale floor that preserves minimal instance counts for cold-start stability.
- For burst handling to ~350 QPS we suggest reserving burstable capacity (2–3 extra nodes) and enabling prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts to shave token latency.
- 8k token sequences are where kernel selection and memory layout matter — we'll bring sample perf data from a similar healthcare summarization workload.

I've attached the throughput-sla-sample.docx and a short checklist of what we'll review. If Alyssa can drop the 1-hour trace (CSV) into the Zoom chat or the HubSpot deal, that will let us size more precisely during the call.
